up: Return a list of distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4651402. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL ID and preferred name. Ensure the results are distinct (one row per compound).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4651402';
